reviews.title: Not free
reviews.text: I can see that it was very helpful but it’s not free I do understand that’s how they make their money but at the end of the day if you want to help people why not make it free or if anything do more than 3 days free trial atleast 15 days and that’ll make someone decide if they wanna pay for an app.

reviews.title: ???Help??
reviews.text: I loved the free trial it was so cool and actually fun, not draining yourself by writing your feelings and feeling empty. I couldn’t do it after my 3 day free trial because I am not in the U.S. PLEASE make available for Canadians!!!

reviews.title: Why?
reviews.text: Forced to do free trail in order use the app

reviews.title: I don’t see a way to use it without paying for beyond
reviews.text: Based on the beginning I will give it three stars but since it looks like I’m blocked from doing anything without paying for it I don’t know, if their is a way to continue without paying please let me know

reviews.title: Dishonest
reviews.text: I do not appreciate you advertising yourself as a free app but then giving me a screen for the free trial version of your app that I can’t exit without accepting. Of course I didn’t accept it- are you nuts? Deleted your app immediately. Even if there’s no payment immediately- I still want to option to only have the free version without having to do some song and dance with some free trial of a premium version I don’t even want. It’s just ridiculous that I can’t even enjoy this “free” app without having to make some sort of financial commitment up front. Ridiculous.

reviews.title: Great app for self-discovery!
reviews.text: I have been using the Innie app for several months. I love completing the journal prompts and the quests. It has helped me to identify patterns within myself and to understand things in my life with new perspectives. Definitely give it a try!

So happy with this app. It’s really surprised me how much I’ve learned about myself and how accurate it is. The questions are fun, but also get really deep. I’d recommend it to anyone wanting to get to know themselves better.

reviews.title: You need to pay

reviews.title: Full of bugs! Beware!
reviews.text: Almost completed onboarding… when I got to the “we should pair up - “place your thumbs on the screen” the screen changes to my avatar and just freezes. App is completely unresponsive. I’ve tried offloading and reloading the app and it just keeps getting stuck at this same screen!!!

reviews.title: A journal that actually sticks ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

It gives you a prompt or you can just rewrite so it’s nice when I want a journal, but I don’t know what a journal about.

reviews.title: I love innie sm

reviews.title: Great app!!
reviews.text: I downloaded innie a few weeks ago, I used to be someone who was never into self help or journaling and this completly changed my mindset! It incorporates self help with fun journaling prompts that make it so easy to journal :)

reviews.title: Innie is the best journaling app
reviews.text: This is the best self reflection app I’ve tried and I’ve tried a lot of them! I also love the little creature that helps you on your journey it’s so cute

reviews.title: best app
reviews.text: this app has helped me SO much with self discovery. My therapist recommended this and it’s been such a game changer.

reviews.title: Favorite self-awareness app!
reviews.text: I am absolutely a fan of the Innie app for personal growth, self-awareness and to support my healing journey. It’s been such a great tool to always have in my pocket. So grateful!!✨🙏🏼🤍

reviews.title: LOVE
reviews.text: I love using innie as my personal journal! The app is engaging and a great way to spend time reflecting on myself and it has made my mental health so much better!!!

reviews.title: Love this app!!
reviews.text: This app is helping me find myself and heal in ways that even my therapist wasn’t able to. I love that it’s at my finger tips anytime I want to take a moment to gather my thoughts and journal or get some thought provoking inward questions.

reviews.title: I love Innie!!!
reviews.text: This app has helped me so much focus and learn about myself. The daily journal helps me place all my thoughts in one place. Try this out to feel more grounded !!

reviews.title: Basically free therapy!
reviews.text: I love using innie. It truly keeps me in tune with all my emotions, and sometimes it’s nice to just a have a place to journal and really dig deep into my thoughts. I highly recommend this app if you’re someone like me who usually pushes all my emotions to the side!

reviews.title: Love Innie
reviews.text: I’m just waiting on my constellation lol. I’m thinking it’s still a WIP feature. I downloaded this the moment it came live on the store. I finish all quizzes the moment more are added so there have been many lulls during my journey. I love the journal that was added. When I finish the round of quizzes, I try to remember to journal instead. I can’t wait to see where this goes and I recommend the app to everyone.

reviews.title: Account Gone?
reviews.text: Had an account. Went to go on app in and it said there was a connection error, signed me out. Tried to log back in and it looks like my account was wiped and all the work I have done in the app has disappeared :( really disappointing.
